title: Bridge and Lantern
author: Lior Marchetti
blurb: Ivo Okafor, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
